issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation says 'vào nước Đức Chúa Trời' (into the Kingdom of the German God/God of Germany) instead of 'vào την βασιλειαν του Θεου' (into the kingdom of God). The word 'Đức' in this context is likely a mistranslation or a confusing insertion, as it is not present in the Greek.
